title: MSRyzen: An Agentic Platform for Unified Proteomics Analysis and Evidence-Centric Visualization
abstract: arXiv:2611.27246v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mass spectrometry (MS)-based proteomics is essential for comprehensive protein characterization, yet it relies on multistep computational workflows that typically demand tedious manual parameter tuning and complex software integration. Here, we present MSRyzen, an agent-driven framework that provides automated parameter optimization and extensible tool integration across bottom-up and top-down proteomics workflows. MSRyzen translates natural-language prompts into directed acyclic workflow graphs, optimizes analytical parameters guided by quantitative metrics and user-defined objectives, and incorporates new third-party software through standardized callable interfaces. Across four public top-down datasets, automated parameter optimization increased proteoform identifications by 3.6% to 15.8% compared to default settings at a 1% false discovery rate. translated_abstract: 基于质谱（MS）的蛋白质组学对于全面的蛋白质表征至关重要，但它依赖于多步骤的计算工作流程，通常需要繁琐的手动参数调整和复杂的软件集成。在此，我们提出了MSRyzen，这是一个由智能体驱动的框架，可在自下而上（bottom-up）和自上而下（top-down）的蛋白质组学工作流程中提供自动化参数优化和可扩展的工具集成。MSRyzen将自然语言提示转换为有向无环工作流图，在定量指标和用户自定义目标的引导下优化分析参数，并通过标准化可调用接口集成新的第三方软件。在四个公开的自上而下蛋白质组学数据集上，与默认设置相比，自动化参数优化在1%假发现率下将蛋白质形态鉴定数量提高了3.6%至15.8%。为确保透明的数据解读，交互式可视化界面协调……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: MSRyzen是一个智能体驱动的蛋白质组学分析平台，可将自然语言提示转化为工作流图、自动优化分析参数并通过标准化接口集成第三方工具，在1%假发现率下使蛋白质形态鉴定数量提升3.6%至15.8%。
en_tdlr: MSRyzen is an agentic platform that translates natural-language prompts into workflow graphs, automatically optimizes analysis parameters, and integrates third-party tools via standardized interfaces, increasing proteoform identifications by 3.6% to 15.8% at a 1% false discovery rate.
